data.one_liner: A widget that visualises a tree structure, where a node can be any widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TreeView widget to display hierarchical tree structures in Flutter. Nodes within the tree can be represented by any custom widget.
use_when: You need to display hierarchical data or file systems as a tree
You want custom widgets to act as tree nodes
avoid_when: You require complex virtualized tree lists with thousands of items
You need built-in advanced drag-and-drop tree editing
strengths: Simple and straightforward to set up
Allows any widget to be used as a tree node
weaknesses: Limited advanced features compared to dedicated enterprise tree packages
Minimal documentation and features beyond basic tree display
